passages.text: Our class is practising road observation in a model street on the playground. The teacher asks each pupil to look left, then look right, and keep checking before crossing. Ben notices a bicycle hidden partly behind a tall cardboard box. He waits until he can see the whole route instead of copying the pupil ahead. Afterwards, our group moves the box and discusses how objects can block a clear view. The exercise reminds us that knowing a routine matters less if we stop watching the actual road.

parallelText.en: Our class is practising road observation in a model street on the playground.
parallelText.zh: 我们班在操场的模拟街道上练习道路观察。

parallelText.en: The teacher asks each pupil to look left, then look right, and keep checking before crossing.
parallelText.zh: 老师请每位同学先向左看，再向右看，过街前持续观察。

parallelText.en: Ben notices a bicycle hidden partly behind a tall cardboard box.
parallelText.zh: 本发现一辆自行车被高纸箱遮住了一部分。

parallelText.en: He waits until he can see the whole route instead of copying the pupil ahead.
parallelText.zh: 他等到能看清整条路线，而不是照搬前面同学的动作。

parallelText.en: Afterwards, our group moves the box and discusses how objects can block a clear view.
parallelText.zh: 之后，我们小组移开箱子，讨论物体如何挡住视线。

parallelText.en: The exercise reminds us that knowing a routine matters less if we stop watching the actual road.
parallelText.zh: 这次练习提醒我们：若不观察实际道路，只知道一套动作也不够。

passages.text: Mia and her aunt are on their way to the library with a bag of donated books. They try a new lane because the usual street is closed for repairs. At a fork, they realise they could lose their way if they keep guessing. Instead, they stop by a shop and compare the street sign with the aunt's map. A worker confirms that the library is just beyond the next corner, beside the park. They arrive only a little late and explain the useful route check to the librarian.

parallelText.en: Mia and her aunt are on their way to the library with a bag of donated books.
parallelText.zh: 米娅和姨妈带着一袋捐赠书，正去图书馆。

parallelText.en: They try a new lane because the usual street is closed for repairs.
parallelText.zh: 常走的街道维修封闭，她们尝试一条新巷子。

parallelText.en: At a fork, they realise they could lose their way if they keep guessing.
parallelText.zh: 走到岔路，她们意识到继续猜方向可能迷路。

parallelText.en: Instead, they stop by a shop and compare the street sign with the aunt's map.
parallelText.zh: 于是她们在店旁停下，把路牌与姨妈的地图比较。

parallelText.en: A worker confirms that the library is just beyond the next corner, beside the park.
parallelText.zh: 工作人员确认图书馆就在下一个转角后、公园旁。

parallelText.en: They arrive only a little late and explain the useful route check to the librarian.
parallelText.zh: 她们只迟到了一会儿，并向图书管理员讲起这次有用的查路。
